headline: Evening hours, twelve weeks
statements: Three evenings a week. One budget. One hire to decide.
note: Detail: the document and its memo page, handed to everyone in the room.

headline: Members asked for evenings
note: From the autumn survey. The library closes at 17:00 today.

headline: The pilot runs for 12 weeks
note: Weeks 1 to 4 test the rota on two evenings before the third is added.

headline: The budget is enough
statements: Most of it pays the coordinator
note: 20 hours a week for 12 weeks is 240 hours, about $14K. About $4K covers lighting, a key-safe and the rota.

headline: Hire the coordinator this week
note: Recommended: hire. A volunteer-only rota leaves one evening in four unstaffed.
